title: The future of feedback: Motivating performance improvement through future-focused feedback
author: Jackie Gnepp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bftsjnne

steps.title: Form Dyads and Assign Roles
steps.instruction: Organize participants into pairs and assign roles of Regional Manager or District Manager randomly using instruction envelopes.

substeps.instruction: Pair group members randomly into dyads
Randomly assign the role of Regional Manager or District Manager to each member by providing the corresponding envelope of instructions

steps.title: Assign Group Condition
steps.instruction: Assign intact groups (e.g., a specific workshop or class) to either the Pre-Post group or the Post-Only group.

substeps.instruction: Assign the Pre-Post group to receive questionnaires both before and after the discussion
Assign the Post-Only group to receive a questionnaire only after the discussion

steps.title: Prepare Participants for Procedure
steps.instruction: Direct each dyad to a private room with a packet containing printed instructions, background information, and questionnaires.

substeps.instruction: Instruct participants to open the instructions packet only after arriving in the room

steps.title: Execute Pre-Post Group Timeline
steps.instruction: For dyads in the Pre-Post group, follow the specified time allocations for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Allow 15 minutes to review the personnel file
Allow 5 minutes to complete the pre-discussion questionnaire
Allow 20 minutes to hold the feedback discussion
Allow 15 minutes to complete the post-discussion questionnaire
